# Sprite Editor — Snapshot

Reserved folder for a frozen, kid-safe copy of the Sprite Editor reference
used by Lesson 16. The current Lesson 16 ships a self-contained mini-scene
("Bubby's World") rendered as inline SVG inside `index.html`, so this folder
is intentionally empty for v1.

When v2 wires the actual Sprite Editor source, drop a read-only snapshot here.
